data.one_liner: An implicit animation widget that flips from one number to another.
data.what_it_does: An implicit animation widget that smoothly flips between numbers. It supports custom text styles, decimals, negative values, prefixes, suffixes, and separators.
use_when: You need to display constantly changing numeric data with a rolling digit animation.
You want to display formatted numbers with custom prefixes, suffixes, and separators like thousands and decimals.
avoid_when: You are building static text displays where animations are unnecessary.
strengths: Supports customizable styles, decimals, and negative values.
Handles prefix, suffix, and thousand separators cleanly.
Easy to use like any other implicit animation widget.
weaknesses: Limited to numeric flipping animations and related formatting.
